component.name: MixAI Music
component.summary: Play the music on your own MixAI Server
Muzica de pe propriul tău MixAI Server

description.p: MixAI Music plays the music library on your own MixAI Server, with a desktop interface and native controls.

ul.li: Albums, artists, playlists, genres and search
Radio and mixes from any track, album or artist
Synced lyrics, queue editing, crossfade and volume normalisation
Media keys and the system Now Playing controls (MPRIS)
Tray mini player and global shortcuts

description.p: MixAI Music needs a MixAI Server (free, self-hosted) on your network or over the internet. Your music stays on your server.

screenshot.caption: Music home on the demo server

description.p: First release of MixAI Music for the desktop.
